capabilities.title: Bounded saturated-liquid viscosity and dense-fluid conductivity estimation
capabilities.limitations: Correlation evaluation only, not experimental qualification. Letsou-Stiel estimates pure saturated-liquid viscosity without mixture or pressure correction. Chung takes pure-fluid or supplied conformal parameters. CO2 uses the Laesecke-Muzny background correlation without critical enhancement and requires a separately established physical gas or compressed-fluid state. The dilute-only CO2 API explicitly permits extrapolation above 2000 K. Default model selection is unchanged; the background CO2 implementation also serves the existing Span-Wagner default.

operations.applicability: Finite positive T, M, Tc and Pc, finite acentric factor and 0.76 <= T/Tc <= 0.98. Saturated-liquid estimate only, no pressure correction or mixture rule.

Original Chung conductivity coefficients, finite positive required constants, nonnegative density and association, 0.3 <= 1.2593*T/Tc <= 100 and packing fraction below one. No critical enhancement or universal accuracy claim.

Pure CO2 background viscosity, 100 <= T <= 2000 K, finite nonnegative mass density. Includes dilute, initial-density and residual terms, excludes critical enhancement. Callers must establish a physical fluid state inside the published gas/compressed-fluid domain; scalar checks do not enforce melting or phase stability.
Pure CO2 zero-density viscosity. 100 <= T <= 10000 K; values above 2000 K are the explicitly documented extrapolation, not finite-density predictions.

capabilities.title: Frozen-EOS compositional tank replay and bounded volume matching
capabilities.limitations: Discovery and inspectApi only; instance-based Java/Python API. Frozen laboratory EOS, fixed-temperature pore volume and supplied initial phase fractions. Original measured-component mode preserves prescribed composition. Opt-in equilibrium-phase molar extraction predicts produced component amounts using explicit substeps; refine pressure/composition/outputs and reject unavailable or exhausted phases. PvtSeparatorPath gives component-conservative equilibrium surface products on an explicit final T/P basis, retaining offgas condensate and water. No inferred phase rates, relative permeability, well deliverability or measured surface-rate inversion. IndependentGasLabTankTest adds a separately generated gas-only synthetic laboratory calibration/whole-CCE holdout/tank matching benchmark with named injection and held-out composition/actual gas-volume checks; no oil is present and GOR remains undefined. Pressure-only bounded volume matching/heldouts and optional segregated finite aquifer retain their existing limits; aquifer water cannot be produced as EOS aqueous phase. Synthetic/analytical/direct-EOS checks are not independent public laboratory-to-field or measured produced-phase validation. No EOS retuning, rock/thermal/spatial model, correlated-error inference or recoverable-reserves claim. The independent gas-only chain separately qualifies constant-rate uniformly mixed gas ODE refinement, constant-inventory composition change and no-flow/injection-only/withdrawal-only limits; 64 substeps fail the declared one-mole mixing target and 1024 meet it. This does not qualify inflow or spatial displacement. Independent gas-only unequal-sigma inversion checks synthetic perturbations, sigma scaling, held-out exclusion and active/inactive bound diagnostics; supplied sigmas are not measured uncertainty or a posterior interval. Opt-in fromSampleComposition derives gas/oil/aqueous EOS volume fractions at reservoir T/P and preserves accepted sample bulk composition across trial volumes; the original explicit-phase constructor can imply a different bulk mixture. Unsupported/duplicate phases fail. The independent binary PR same-sample reference adds whole two-phase CCE holdouts and pressure/composition/GOR predictions; synthetic numerical agreement is not measured accuracy or general critical-domain qualification.

capabilities.title: Native CCE/CVD/DLE laboratory path and bounded generalized PVT
capabilities.limitations: Discovery and inspectApi only; instance data/protocol inputs, no executable static MCP operation. Modified-black-oil generate requires a dry sample with gas and oil at every pressure, a fixed separator basis, separately accepted pure-water Bw and caller-justified surface conversion tolerance. Native replayNative preserves selected original/tuned EOS and complete experiment identity. Wet CCE retains gas/oil/aqueous cells and all water components with zero withdrawal using caller-accepted wet EOS/multiphase settings; aqueous separator products remain explicit. Path.CCE uses ConstantMassExpansion.runNativeExpansion for closed-mass absolute states without a saturation scan or withdrawal; numerical closure error is not production. Oil-only DLE and pre-dew gas-only CVD are supported within their recorded bounds. CVD requires a sampled gas/oil boundary and continues gas withdrawal to fixed cell volume through dry liquid disappearance; native upper-dew refinement now checks the scan-selected branch, normalized nontrivial phase compositions and log-fugacity closure; the declared binary independent reference passes. Legacy default and modified-black-oil generation retain the scan and its precision limitation. Native DLE uses DifferentialLiberation.runNativeLiberation to remove equilibrium gas while retaining oil/aqueous inventories; two liquids without gas give zero withdrawal. Saturation-referenced wet CVD and critical-degenerate paths remain unqualified. Explicit replayNativeFixedCell uses the initial occupied EOS volume, preserves reference metadata/checkpoints/separator provenance and runs transactionally. It supports unchanged gas-bearing gas/oil/aqueous families, including absent oil, under the216state independent benchmark; phase-family changes are rejected by that existing method. Named replayNativeWetGasFixedCell/core runWetGasFixedCellDepletion supports explicitly initial-volume-referenced gas/aqueous paths with aqueous disappearance (appearance remains unqualified), retained gas and no oil. It retains water in gas withdrawals, actual separator products, immutable checkpoints and distinct allowsWetGasPhaseChanges metadata; 27 independent binary SRK paths at three scales cover270states and both checkpoint selections; another27off-grid20-pressure paths cover540reference states/1080checkpoint comparisons at the same bounds, with separate zero-water, serialization, oil/missing-gas and volume-basis checks. This is not wet upper-dew inference, oil-containing wet-transition qualification or measured accuracy. Named replayNativeDryPhaseChangingFixedCell/core runDryPhaseChangingFixedCellDepletion permits dry oil appearance/disappearance with retained gas and explicit allowsDryPhaseChanges protocol metadata. Independent binary SRK common-tangent/cubic/lever-rule predictions cover27paths/243states at three scales and both checkpoint selections, including a bounded binary stability audit, gas-only tail limit, immutable restart and all separator inventories. That dry route still rejects water/aqueous, absent gas, critical-degenerate and unclosed paths. Each local refinement preserves its own accepted phase family; no shared flash defaults change. This is not wet upper-dew inference or measured accuracy. Explicit fixed-cell precision reuses bounded multiphase beta refinement with 1e-12 equilibrium/volume stopping targets, preserved phase family/Gibbs/component gates and original216/intermediate480state fixed-bound synthetic tests; arbitrary sample-scale absolute precision is not guaranteed. No invented absent-phase Bo/Bg/Rs/Rv, saturation-normalized CCE values, measured laboratory/field accuracy or recoverable-reserves claim.

capabilities.title: Integrated compressor control, shutdown, relief/disposal and native P&ID workflow
capabilities.limitations: Public packaged Java CLI plus Java/JPype object workflow, with inspectApi discovery only; no new curated MCP runDynamic execution option or PLC application generator. CompressorAutomationWorkflow accepts strict design JSON or public defaults, a new output directory and an optional canonical proposal; supported controls are freshly applied/read back, unsupported SIF-policy edits fail closed, subsets are disclosed, and raw native fingerprints remain distinct from strict normalized-file hashes. Its additive integrated overload requires exactly one blocked-outlet case and an explicit CompressorReliefDisposalStudy.Design, then joins stable synthetic requirement and equipment-tag identities to the exact native-result fingerprint, physical relief/disposal result, review state and strict output checksum. The legacy overload performs no relief calculation. The compressor train uses a declared thermodynamic/map/capacity basis, actual recycle gas-Cv hydraulics and finite suction and discharge inventories within its supported execution contract. The opt-in CompressorReliefDisposalStudy copies the executed discharge receiver into the existing governed relief/blowdown/flare calculation and reports explicit input units, mass closure, pressure decay, cooling, header and flare capacity without changing the source case. Quasi-steady compressor maps and explicit driver profile/rate do not establish rotor-inertia, reverse-flow, mechanical/acoustic surge or a complete utility network. Generated maps, assumed valves, BDV/PSV geometry, flare capacities and study limits remain synthetic until supplied and qualified. Canonical control settings must be applied/read back on an isolated native copy and fresh scenario evidence must match current source/configuration fingerprints. Proposed instrumentation and direct model-derived anti-surge inputs are not executed measurement chains. Expected physical FAILs, no-demand outcomes and numerical/conservation/timestep limits remain separate from software-test success. Agent/skill routing and source/test references are discovery evidence, not standards, vendor, HAZOP/SRS/SIL/IPL, MDMT, detailed flare-hydraulics, installed independence, receiving-tool or construction qualification.

capabilities.title: Two-circuit exchanger instrumentation, P&ID/DEXPI, thermal dynamics and PID tuning
capabilities.limitations: Public Java/JPype object workflow, discoverable through inspectApi; no new curated MCP execution schema or PLC application generator. Automatic cooling-loop helper requires an actual native utility valve directly feeding side 1 in process order, explicit thermal inputs and unique tags. Nine actual TT/PT/FT devices and one native TIC share canonical bindings with native four-port drawings and DEXPI 2.0.1. HeatExchanger with thermal dynamics enabled is a constant-pressure, fixed-composition, positive-throughflow single-phase model with two mixed fluid enthalpy inventories and a wall; nominal volumes initialize fixed masses, with no thermal expansion, hydraulic pressure/hammer, phase change or distributed counterflow. Classical EOS mixing and reference water/seawater are the supported property basis. Film coefficients and area govern thermal mode; configured steady NTU/UA is retained for the default steady mode. Native snapshot rollback and raw NeqSimXtream restart retain dynamic state; the convenience ProcessSystem loader reinitializes steady state. Candidate PID studies run isolated native copies, retain failures and traces, and accept only the declared final-window and thermal-residual criteria. Same-build full serialized runtime fingerprints normalize only selected PID gains/setpoint; changed properties, policy, history or source state invalidate evidence. Applying a recommendation requires a new revision and fresh canonical bindings. Executable policy stays in the native model/canonical sidecar, not XML-only PLC transfer. Routing, schema/profile conformance and test presence do not establish plant/vendor, receiving-tool, SRS/SIL/IPL, standards or construction qualification. Missing fail action, relief and line design remain HOLD.
